assess.scope: 雇主不断从较低利润转向较高利润的事业，有强烈趋势使各业利润率趋于均等。
assess.reason: “This restless desire on the part of all the employers of stock, to quit a less profitable for a more advantageous business, has a strong tendency to equalize the rate of profits”写的是利润被拉平的倾向。
assess.limitation: 这句没有当作1817年之后仍待核验的结果去检索。
assess.method: 原文把关系写在同一比较或假设里。
